instructions_to_main_agent: Build a production-quality, fully responsive Indian B2B Solar Intelligence, Savings, Project Evaluation & Financing Platform.
Implement the EFL NBFC (Electronica Finance Limited - Renewable Energy Funding) branding & loan workflow (loans up to ₹3 Cr, collateral-free up to ₹50 Lakhs, 3-day approval).
Ensure all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, selects, modal triggers) include explicit `data-testid` attributes (e.g. data-testid='solar-calc-submit-btn', data-testid='discom-select').
Include a rich state switcher / DISCOM selector covering Indian states (Maharashtra, Gujarat, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, NCR, Rajasthan, etc.).

Provide rich interactive calculators with real-time recalculations for CAPEX vs OPEX, Section 32 Accelerated Depreciation (40%), Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR), Payback period, and 25-Year Cumulative Savings.
Support a detailed report export/view mode (Bankable Detailed Project Report) with print and download capability.
Never use generic white backgrounds or transparent dropdown menus. Maintain dark fintech visual elegance throughout.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors must look deep, rich, and intentional with clear visual hierarchy.
Do NOT center align the main application container.
Ensure hover states explicitly specify text color to maintain APCA readability.
Every card with a border must have adequate internal padding (p-5 to p-8).
Always test responsive layouts for mobile and desktop screens.
